scope: diagnostic shadow fits only; no replacement policy, learned inference, tuning, downloads, Stage7B, commit or push
partition: reuse all saved component assignments byte-for-byte; never repartition, rebalance or retry
fit_observations: all original raw matches of that arm assigned to fit components, sorted lexicographically; do not collapse or filter fit observations
validation_observations: one actual raw union match per grouped validation edge, lexicographically smallest (i,j); identical pixels and memberships for both candidate poses, no coordinate averaging
eligibility: reuse previous per-case structural reasons; both arms skip all seeds if any reason; retain all planned rows
backend: unchanged Stage6 reconstruct and fixed Stage6 configuration; only override declared geometry seed
primary_signal: source-balanced capped sqrt-Sampson loss: half mean over validation B edges plus half mean over validation C edges; shared edges have one stored row with summed weights, not independent duplicate observations
secondary_signals: same loss on common, B-only and C-only strata; empty strata unknown
source-balanced and 8x6-cell-balanced capped loss; observed cells fixed for both poses
validation dual-positive depth and original parallax/reprojection support; no pose modification
comparison: report B/C/tie/unknown per diagnostic only; no output pose selection, hybrid scores, threshold fitting or GT rescue
GT: separate evaluation command after all diagnostic outputs are saved; attach original focus labels and assess newly fitted poses separately from original full-fit outcomes
interpretation: endpoint-level geometric holdout only; not independent matching, disjoint spatial blocks or unseen-object validation
